invariants.invariant: G_s = open_flag A_f D_s f_up f_down/(d_up f_down + d_down f_up) (two half-cells in series), J_s = G_s (C_up - C_down) with C_up, C_down and f_up, f_down from the connected volumes, J_down = J, J_up = -J (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(G_glc, open_flag*A_f*D_glc*va__f_hind*vb__f_hind/(d_up*vb__f_hind + d_down*va__f_hind), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_glc, G_glc*(va__C_glc - vb__C_glc), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-35) and np.array_equal(J_glc_down, J_glc) and np.array_equal(J_glc_up, -J_glc) and np.allclose(G_lac, open_flag*A_f*D_lac*va__f_hind*vb__f_hind/(d_up*vb__f_hind + d_down*va__f_hind), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_lac, G_lac*(va__C_lac - vb__C_lac), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-35) and np.array_equal(J_lac_down, J_lac) and np.array_equal(J_lac_up, -J_lac) and np.allclose(G_H, open_flag*A_f*D_H*va__f_hind*vb__f_hind/(d_up*vb__f_hind + d_down*va__f_hind), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_H, G_H*(va__C_H - vb__C_H), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-35) and np.array_equal(J_H_down, J_H) and np.array_equal(J_H_up, -J_H) and np.allclose(G_O2, open_flag*A_f*D_O2*va__f_hind*vb__f_hind/(d_up*vb__f_hind + d_down*va__f_hind), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_O2, G_O2*(va__C_O2 - vb__C_O2), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-35) and np.array_equal(J_O2_down, J_O2) and np.array_equal(J_O2_up, -J_O2)

invariants.invariant: mass is conserved across the face for every species: V_a C_a + V_b C_b constant (H+ with its buffer, V (1 + b_H) C_H; relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.ptp(va__V_e*va__C_glc + vb__V_e*vb__C_glc) <= 1e-9*np.max(np.abs(va__V_e*va__C_glc + vb__V_e*vb__C_glc)) and np.ptp(va__V_e*va__C_lac + vb__V_e*vb__C_lac) <= 1e-9*np.max(np.abs(va__V_e*va__C_lac + vb__V_e*vb__C_lac)) and np.ptp((1 + va__b_H)*va__V_e*va__C_H + (1 + va__b_H)*vb__V_e*vb__C_H) <= 1e-9*np.max(np.abs((1 + va__b_H)*va__V_e*va__C_H + (1 + va__b_H)*vb__V_e*vb__C_H)) and np.ptp(va__V_e*va__C_O2 + vb__V_e*vb__C_O2) <= 1e-9*np.max(np.abs(va__V_e*va__C_O2 + vb__V_e*vb__C_O2))

invariants.invariant: exact solution with the matrix held: C_a - C_b = (C_a0 - C_b0) exp(-G (1/K_a + 1/K_b) t), K the capacity (V, or V (1 + b_H) for H+) (relative 1e-6 of the initial difference)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((va__C_glc - vb__C_glc) - (va__C_glc[0] - vb__C_glc[0])*np.exp(-G_glc[0]*(1/(va__V_e[0]) + 1/(vb__V_e[0]))*t))) <= 1e-6*abs(va__C_glc[0] - vb__C_glc[0]) + 1e-18 and np.max(np.abs((va__C_lac - vb__C_lac) - (va__C_lac[0] - vb__C_lac[0])*np.exp(-G_lac[0]*(1/(va__V_e[0]) + 1/(vb__V_e[0]))*t))) <= 1e-6*abs(va__C_lac[0] - vb__C_lac[0]) + 1e-18 and np.max(np.abs((va__C_H - vb__C_H) - (va__C_H[0] - vb__C_H[0])*np.exp(-G_H[0]*(1/((1 + va__b_H)*va__V_e[0]) + 1/((1 + va__b_H)*vb__V_e[0]))*t))) <= 1e-6*abs(va__C_H[0] - vb__C_H[0]) + 1e-18 and np.max(np.abs((va__C_O2 - vb__C_O2) - (va__C_O2[0] - vb__C_O2[0])*np.exp(-G_O2[0]*(1/(va__V_e[0]) + 1/(vb__V_e[0]))*t))) <= 1e-6*abs(va__C_O2[0] - vb__C_O2[0]) + 1e-18

invariants.invariant: second law: each species flows down its gradient, J_s (C_up - C_down) >= 0, so the entropy produced, sum J_s R ln(C_up/C_down) / T, is never negative
invariants.expr: np.all(J_glc*(va__C_glc - vb__C_glc) >= 0) and np.all(J_lac*(va__C_lac - vb__C_lac) >= 0) and np.all(J_H*(va__C_H - vb__C_H) >= 0) and np.all(J_O2*(va__C_O2 - vb__C_O2) >= 0)

invariants.invariant: the matrix slows diffusion: with matrix on one side G_s is below the open-water conductance A_f D_s/(d_up + d_down)
invariants.expr: np.all(G_glc <= open_flag*A_f*D_glc/(d_up + d_down)*(1 + 1e-12)) and np.all(G_lac <= open_flag*A_f*D_lac/(d_up + d_down)*(1 + 1e-12)) and np.all(G_H <= open_flag*A_f*D_H/(d_up + d_down)*(1 + 1e-12)) and np.all(G_O2 <= open_flag*A_f*D_O2/(d_up + d_down)*(1 + 1e-12))
